title: [PM corpus] rules only, plain language: strip provenance narratives and incident post-mortems from the pm-dispatch skill corpus (maintainer 2026-09-04) — member 1: SKILL.md
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) on a maintainer ruling given in the live PM chat, 2026-09-04 13:1xZ. Execution family under the corpus-audit anchor #13597 (Phase 3 continues under this ruling, which supersedes the narrower X0 quote policy where the two differ).

## The ruling (verbatim, untranslated)

The maintainer asked whether the PM skills should be re-reviewed for readability — 「要不要把所有的项目经理 skills 再复核一遍，语言改的通顺一点，便于人类审核，目前我看起来好累」 — and, on the seat's core-vs-secondary reading, ruled:

> 各条规则的出处叙事、事故复盘 根本不重要啊，不需要写入skills啊

⇒ **Provenance narratives and incident post-mortems do not belong in the skill corpus at all. The corpus carries rules only, in plain language a human can review.**

## What this changes

- Every rule keeps its **operative content** (what to do, what never to do, the thresholds and names it depends on). What goes: who said it when, which incident produced it, which day it was measured, the "this is why" story — unless the story IS the rule's condition (then one clause, no date, no quote).
- A maintainer quotation stays only where the quoted words are themselves the criterion the reader tests against (the four-axes frame block is one such: it is watched byte-for-byte by `check:skill-frame-sync` and is ⛔ untouched). Everything else quoted becomes the rule in plain words.
- Language: each file keeps its current language (the pm-dispatch corpus and `os-dev.md` are Chinese with English identifiers; `AGENTS.md` is English). One rule per sentence; ⛔ only for prohibitions; no ⚠️/⭐ emphasis; no issue numbers in operational text (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`).
- Net **shrink only** — every ratchet ceiling stays where it is; the rewrite never buys lines. The seat re-locks ceilings once after the family lands (programme rule).

## Members (one governed PR each, in this order; the seat dispatches serially)

| # | file(s) | size today (`a3fbd200`) | flight |
|---|---|--:|---|
| 1 | `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 971 lines · 142 ⛔ · 124 quotes · 97 dates | this card |
| 2 | `references/dispatch-runbook.md` · `review-checklist.md` · `contract-review.md` · `landing-operations.md` · `seat-post-protocol.md` · `state-machine.md` · `decision-analysis.md` | ≈720 lines | member card |
| 3 | `references/platform-readings.md` · `rest-channel.md` · `lanes/*.md` · `release-aftercare.md` · `true-green.md` · `compile-surfaces.md` | ≈900 lines | member card (readings ledger: facts stay, narratives go) |
| 4 | `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 450 lines · 41 ⛔ · 53 quotes | member card |
| 5 | `AGENTS.md` | 1161 lines (English) | member card, last |

## Human review, by design

Each PR body carries a **rule inventory** — one row per rule: section · rule as it now reads · what was removed (narrative / quote / date) · "operative content unchanged" — so the maintainer reviews the table, not the diff. The seat's contract-tier review checks the inventory against the diff before requesting the two approvers.

## Gates every member must keep green

`check:pm-skill-ratchet` (line count and 120-byte lines; shrink only) · `check:skill-frame-sync` (the frame block byte-identical in its two copies) · `check:pm-governed-prose` (the instruction surfaces still name the five governed surfaces) · `check:pm-skill-id-lint` · `check:nul-bytes` · `check:pm-governed-merges` · the whole-repo lint · whatever `dispatch-gates --commands` derives for the paths.

Refs: #13597 (anchor; Phase 1–2 tables and rulings) · #14685 items 2–5 (the earlier X0 / excerpt / frame / move rulings) · #12911 (the thesis).
